en-US.description: Qualified electronic signature application by Disig
en-US.longDescription: Desktop Signer is an application developed by Disig for creating, verifying, and managing qualified electronic signatures and seals.
en-US.name: Desktop Signer
en-US.releaseNotes:
- Archive: document retention period, deleting documents by filter, JSON export and import of the archive database
- License management and file extension associations in application settings
- English localization
- New signature core ESToolkit 4.7.16 with signature validation at a given time
- Updated list of acceptable algorithms
- .xdcf files are processed as XML documents
- Fixed import of MEF packages after the October 2026 .NET Framework update
- Fixed "Signature policy is not set" error after saving settings
- Fixed validation with TSL services in withdrawn state
